opening_line: Hi everyone, Today, I have some profoundly difficult news to share.
key_quotes: This means 1,271 people, or 22% of Canva, will be impacted.
I'm deeply sorry for the pain and disruption this will cause for everyone affected.
we need to refound Canva, getting back to our roots of small, empowered teams
severance: At least six months salary incl. statutory entitlements globally; one-year vesting cliff removed for joiners in past year; 12 months healthcare (where provided) and EAP incl. family; career coaching, 1yr LinkedIn Premium; keep MacBook; US$10,000 Canva Collective Fund grants; Slack/Gmail access until end of week.
notes: Primary text read via Wayback Machine (direct site 403s). Title 'An important update on our team'; CEO note to staff republished on newsroom same day. 1,271 = people impacted, includes role changes and relocations to hubs (Sydney); number actually exiting not disclosed. Date: Sydney 4 Nov 2026 (Bloomberg stamped 3 Nov). Broke Canva's no-layoff history; earlier 2026 reporting (Startup Daily, Mar 2026) had Canva denying redundancies during Leonardo.AI integration. Company All Hands 10 Nov; org all hands from 11 Nov. AI mentioned only as 'New technology is transforming what people can create'; not named as cause. Access to Slack/Gmail kept until end of week (not locked out).
ceo_voice: Contrite, humane and detailed; first-person apology repeated at open and close, framed as 'refounding' rather than cost-cutting.

I take full responsibility
